title: Admissions Open for Session 2026-27 & 2027-28
body: Limited seats available from Nursery to Class 6th. Visit the campus between 9:00 AM and 3:00 PM or call the admission helpdesk to book a guided visit.

title: Parent-Teacher Meeting — Saturday, 22 November 2026
body: All parents are requested to meet the class teacher between 9:00 AM and 12:30 PM. Please carry the student diary and the last assessment sheet.

title: Winter Uniform from 1 December
body: Students must come in the complete winter uniform from 1 December 2026. Navy blazer, school tie and grey socks are compulsory.

title: Half-Yearly Assessment Datesheet Released
body: The assessment begins on 8 December 2026 for Classes 1 to 6. The datesheet has been shared with class teachers and is displayed on the school notice board.

title: Annual Sports Meet — Save the Date
body: Our annual sports meet will be held in the third week of January 2027. House-wise practice sessions begin from 5 January during the games period.

title: Campus Closed on 18 November
body: The school will remain closed on 18 November 2026 on account of a local holiday. Transport service will not operate that day.
